title: E2E.Adversarial.Password.Rar4.Stored.2026-TESTGRP
description: A stored RAR4 set with encrypted member data across three volumes, submitted once with no password and once with a wrong one, with a configured password list that holds only wrong passwords. Each wrong key fails the member's checksum; the ranges read again are read a bounded piece at a time. Each job fails with the password verdict, once.
